_note: Planning defaults for the illustrative business case. Benchmarks carry a source. Anything marked 'planning assumption' must be validated in discovery. Edit here, not in code.

voice.source: ContactBabel US Contact Center Decision-Makers' Guide 2026, mean inbound call

chat.source: ContactBabel US Contact Center Decision-Makers' Guide 2026, web chat

email.source: ContactBabel US Contact Center Decision-Makers' Guide 2026, email

messaging.source: No independent 2024-26 benchmark found. Set below web chat because messaging is asynchronous

social.source: No independent 2024-26 benchmark found. Set equal to messaging

ai_resolved.source: Gartner median cost per self-service contact (reported Feb 2024)

repeat_share.source: SQM Group: industry average first contact resolution about 70%

contacts_per_agent_per_year.source: About 40 contacts a day, 225 working days

agents_per_qa_analyst.source: Typical span for manual quality sampling

handle_time_realisation.source: Half of time saved converts to cost. Gartner: only 20% of leaders report AI-driven headcount cuts, so model capacity release

ai_resolution.label: AI resolution
ai_resolution.applies: share of assisted contacts newly resolved by AI agents
ai_resolution.reference: Gartner 2024: 14% of issues fully resolved in self-service today. Sprinklr customer: 76% AI agent containment in four months

repeat_reduction.label: Fewer repeat contacts
repeat_reduction.reference: SQM Group: about 30% of contacts are not resolved first time

voice_shift.label: Voice to messaging shift
voice_shift.applies: share of remaining voice contacts moved to messaging
voice_shift.reference: McKinsey 2024: most care leaders expect digital to pass 40% of inbound contacts

handle_time.label: Faster handling
handle_time.applies: handle-time reduction on remaining assisted contacts
handle_time.reference: Sprinklr customers: Uber 89 seconds off case handling; a European airline cut handle time 33%

quality_automation.label: Automated quality
quality_automation.applies: share of manual QA effort automated
quality_automation.reference: McKinsey: automated QA can save more than 50% of QA cost; manual QA covers under 5% of contacts

credibility_note: Gartner (Nov 2026): only 4% of service leaders say AI has delivered the ROI they expected. Lead with the low scenario.
